item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

dialog.agent: What would you like me to do with this clip—trim it, add captions, change its visual style, or something else? If you want only part of it, tell me the start and end times.
dialog.why: It asks the user what edits they want and requests start and end times if only part of the clip is needed.
dialog.user: make it vertical, show the man when he asks and the woman when she answers, each centred. keep all 10 seconds and the original sound, no captions.

dialog.agent:
You want a **10-second vertical (9:16) edit**, centred on the man during his question and the woman during her answer, with **original audio and no captions**.

The connected tools don’t support precise speaker-based cropping or guarantee unchanged audio. Using the AI video editor could alter the footage, so I haven’t run it or spent credits.

This needs a standard video editor: set the canvas to 9:16, split at the speaker change, and centre each speaker in their section while leaving the original audio untouched.
dialog.why: It says the connected tools cannot reliably perform the requested cropping while preserving the original audio, and directs the user to a standard video editor instead.

turns.agent: I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits. No video was created and no credits were spent.
